script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Family
Theme: friendship

Begin screenplay.

FADE IN:

INT. KITCHEN - MORNING

The sun pours through the kitchen windows, casting warm rays upon a cluttered yet cozy space. On the counter, a steaming pot of oatmeal sits, bubbling softly.

At the stove, EMMA (35) stirs the porridge, humming to herself. In walks her younger brother, JAMES (12), wearing a rumpled school uniform.

EMMA
(smiling)
Good morning, Sleepyhead. Did you sleep well?

JAMES
(yawning)
I guess so. But I had the weirdest dream.

EMMA
(curious)
Oh? What was it about?

James hesitates for a moment before sharing.

JAMES
I dreamt I had a superpower. I could make plants grow really fast.

Emma chuckles and sets the pot on the table, pouring the oatmeal into two bowls.

EMMA
That's a wonderful dream. Maybe you'll discover your own special talent one day.

INT. LIVING ROOM - LATER

Emma and James sit side by side on the couch, each engrossed in their own sketchbook.

JAMES
(excited)
Hey, Emma, have you seen this new neighborhood garden? It's huge!

EMMA
(looking up from her sketchbook)
Yes, I've passed by it a few times. It's really lovely.

James leans in, his eyes shining with determination.

JAMES
What if we could make it even more special? What if we started our own community garden?

Emma smiles, appreciating her brother's enthusiasm.

EMMA
That's a fantastic idea, James. We should talk to Mr. Johnson, the garden's caretaker.

INT. GARDEN - DAY

Emma and James approach the garden's entrance, where MR. JOHNSON (50), a kind-faced man with a gardener's apron, greets them warmly.

MR. JOHNSON
Ah, good morning, young lady and gentleman. How may I help you today?

EMMA
Mr. Johnson, we'd like to start a community garden plot. My brother and I are very passionate about gardening and would love to contribute.

Mr. Johnson smiles, pleased.

MR. JOHNSON
Well, I think that's a wonderful idea. We could use some more help around here. Let me show you around and get you started.

INT. GARDEN - LATER

Emma and James work together, planting seeds and tending to the flourishing plants. The sun sets, casting long shadows across the garden, as they sit back on their heels, exhausted yet content.

EMMA
(smiling)
This has been a great day, James. I'm proud of us.

JAMES
(smiling back)
Me too, Emma. We make a good team.

INT. KITCHEN - NIGHT

The siblings sit at the kitchen table, covered in drawings and garden plans, their faces glowing from the soft light streaming in through the windows.

EMMA
(laughing)
You know, James, I think your dream might come true. With this community garden, we'll be helping things grow in more ways than one.

JAMES
(grinning)
I couldn't agree more, Emma.

They share a look, the bond between them growing stronger with each passing day.

FADE OUT.

END OF SCREENPLAY.
